summary: Install-time dropper: base64-hidden setup.py hook fetches and executes a binary from a personal GitHub account
details: setup.py registers a custom install cmdclass whose post_install step decodes a base64 blob and exec()s it at pip install time. On Linux, the decoded hook downloads a binary from https://github.com/totti2188/8gp1Q7iZD3h4VW/releases/download/v1.3A/something to /tmp/something, chmod 0755, and spawns it detached via subprocess.Popen with start_new_session=True. The payload host is a personal GitHub account, not the declared publisher; no hash or signature check is performed. The setup() name is selected at runtime from the PYPI_PACKAGE_NAME environment variable with a default of 'requestss' (a typosquat of 'requests'), while the on-disk import package is named 'djangoo' (a typosquat of 'django'), consistent with a typosquat-and-drop campaign. The package's advertised purpose (HTTP client utilities) is unrelated to any of these behaviors.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
